title: Former Patriots 2024 2nd-round pick abruptly retires from NFL
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Former New England Patriots wide receiver Ja'Lynn Polk retires from the NFL at 24, after two seasons.
Polk, a 2024 second-round draft pick, struggled in New England with 12 catches and 87 yards in 15 games.
Traded to the Saints in 2025, Polk didn't play due to injury but participated in offseason workouts this year.

title: Mother of trooper killed in crash sues Saugus restaurant, alleging it over-served wrong-way driver
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Barbara Trainor sues Saugus restaurant, alleging it over-served Hernan Ramon Marrero, who later caused a fatal crash.
The $20 million lawsuit claims Tribu Mexican Kitchen & Bar served Marrero nine drinks, despite signs of visible intoxication.
The Alcoholic Beverages Control Commission has opened an enforcement case involving Tribu, but no criminal charges were filed.

title: Red Sox trade deadline live updates: Will Craig Breslow make another big move?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox acquired Curtis Mead from Nationals for Connelly Early, but Mead injured with a wrist fracture in debut.
Red Sox chief baseball officer Craig Breslow seeks additional impact bats before MLB trade deadline Monday at 6 p.m.
Rays acquire pitcher Freddy Peralta from Mets, bolstering AL East rivals' rotation with Drew Rasmussen and Shane McClanahan.

title: Man killed in East Boston overnight shooting
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A man was fatally shot near 464 Meridian St. in East Boston early Sunday morning, police reported.
The victim was transported to a hospital and declared dead; his identity is pending autopsy and notification of kin.
Boston Police Department's Homicide Unit is investigating; no arrests have been made and information is sought from the public.

title: 2 men injured in late-night shooting in Dorchester, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men were injured in a shooting on Friday night in Dorchester; both are expected to survive.
The incident occurred around 10:40 p.m. at 31 Hancock St.; police were called to the scene.
Neither suspect has been identified, and no charges have been filed as the investigation continues.

title: Woman trapped, injured in second incident on MBTA Davis escalator this year
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: A woman was injured on an MBTA escalator at Davis Station after her clothing got trapped in the mechanism.
A fellow rider pressed the emergency stop button and assisted the woman, who sustained a hand injury.
This is the second escalator incident at Davis Station this year, following a deadly accident in February.

title: 2 men arrested after allegedly stealing chain, wallet at knifepoint in Dorchester
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Deivi Yoander Sanchez Aguasvivas, 24, and Luis Miguel Ramirez-Astacio, 26, arrested for armed robbery in Dorchester.
A victim reported being robbed at knifepoint by two men on a moped, losing her chain and wallet.
Aguasvivas and Ramirez-Astacio apprehended separately; Aguasvivas arraigned without bail, Ramirez-Astacio had outstanding warrants.

title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends participatory budgeting submission deadline from July 31 to August 7 for $2 million in city funding.
Residents can propose one-time projects for city funding, focusing on advancing racial and social equality.
Final proposals will undergo voting from January 15 to February 15, following community review in fall.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs in the first two at-bats against the Los Angeles Dodgers.
Rafaela's homers came in the first and third innings, tying the game at 2-2 with a 402-foot shot.
Rafaela hit a total of three home runs in the series, reaching 14 for the season by the third inning.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox attempted to trade for Cincinnati Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz before the deadline.
Boston's trade package was prospect-based, but both teams couldn't agree on the deal's framework.
Red Sox seek to fill a middle infield gap after acquiring Curtis Mead, who is sidelined with a wrist injury.
